evals.name: readme-first-turn
evals.prompt: 给我们的 Agent 项目写个 README
evals.expected_output: Grills on who meets the README, in what moment, and what they should do after; writes no README.
assertions: The response asks who reads the README or in what moment
The response asks what the reader should do or feel afterwards

evals.name: sales-deck-verbs
evals.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/wider 帮我做一份业务简报

[助手]
（grill 完成）对象：50 人以下公司的老板；场景：15 分钟的初次面谈，对方多半边看手机边听；希望之后：同意让你们免费试用两周。

[用户·最新]
嗯就是这样，下一步呢？
evals.expected_output: Suggests 2-3 verbs for the deck's job that leave out the noun and name a checkable effect; asks the user to pick or rewrite; no fields yet.
assertions: The response suggests two or three verbs for the job
The suggested verbs leave out the noun (简报/deck)
The response asks the user to pick or rewrite a verb
The response does not yet list fields or techniques
